site.name: notion
site.summary: notion-clone Clone of the Notion marketing funnel: home + product sub-pages + templates + pricing. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: top nav (Product / Download / Solutions / Resources / Pricing / Request demo / Log in / Get Notion free), hero section (product positioning + CTA + main screenshot), modular product intros (Docs / Wikis / Projects / AI), customer logo wall, customer stories, multi-column footer | | `projects.html` | Project management sub-page: feature highlights, view-switching screenshots (Board / Timeline / Calendar), case studies, CTA | | `wikis.html` | Wiki sub-page: knowledge-base examples, permissions / search / template features, CTA |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Notion marketing clone, validating the primary landing flow, product sub-pages, pricing interactions, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start by validating the primary conversion flow on the home page, including CTAs and modals. It will then systematically traverse the product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis) and Templates to verify content rendering and cross-linking. Next, it will deep-dive into the Pricing page's interactive elements like toggles and accordions. Finally, the entire critical flow will be re-evaluated on a mobile viewport to assess layout warnings and tap target usability.
assumptions: CTAs like 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' trigger JavaScript modals or dialogs rather than navigating to new pages.
The pricing toggle switches between Monthly and Yearly views dynamically without a page reload.
FAQ accordions on Pricing and Templates pages expand and collapse content interactively.
The site is a static frontend clone with no backend, so form submissions will not result in actual data saves.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on navigation links and footer links, especially problematic on mobile viewports.
Pricing toggle (Monthly/Yearly) state changes and ensuring price values update correctly.
Modal dialogs triggered by 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' might lack proper close mechanisms or focus trapping.
FAQ accordion buttons might not provide clear visual feedback when expanded/collapsed.

phases.title: Home Page & Primary Flow
phases.objective: Validate the main landing page structure, primary conversion CTAs, and modal interactions.
key_checks: Verify hero section layout and content visibility.
Click 'Request a demo' and validate the resulting dialog/modal content and close behavior.
Click 'Get Notion free' and validate the resulting dialog/modal content and close behavior.
Scroll through modular product intros and verify section transitions.
exit_criteria: Both primary CTAs have been clicked and their modals successfully closed.
Full page scroll from top to footer completed without layout shifts.

phases.title: Product Sub-pages Exploration
phases.objective: Navigate through Projects and Wikis pages to validate content rendering, feature sections, and cross-navigation.
key_checks: Navigate to Projects page via top nav and verify feature highlights load correctly.
Check cross-linking CTAs on Projects page (e.g., 'Wikis Centralize all your knowledge...').
Navigate to Wikis page via top nav and verify knowledge-base examples render.
Check cross-linking CTAs on Wikis page (e.g., 'Projects Manage any type of project...').
exit_criteria: Both Projects and Wikis pages have been visited from the top nav.
At least one cross-link CTA on each page has been clicked and verified.

phases.title: Templates & Pricing Interactions
phases.objective: Deep-dive into interactive elements on the Templates and Pricing pages, specifically toggles and accordions.
key_checks: Navigate to Templates page and click at least two FAQ accordion buttons to verify expand/collapse behavior.
Navigate to Pricing page and interact with the 'Toggle yearly pricing' control, verifying that prices update.
Click FAQ buttons on Pricing page (e.g., 'How does Notion AI use my data?') to check content expansion.
Verify 'Sign up', 'Get started', and 'Contact Sales' buttons presence and click behavior.
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle has been switched back and forth at least once.
At least one FAQ accordion on Templates and one on Pricing have been expanded.
CTA buttons on Pricing have been interacted with.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-evaluate the critical flows and layout warnings on a mobile viewport to ensure responsive design integrity.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify Home page hero section stacks correctly.
Validate tap target spacing for top navigation links on mobile.
Check Pricing page toggle and accordions usability on mobile.
Verify modals ('Request a demo') are usable and do not overflow screen boundaries on mobile.
exit_criteria: Home and Pricing pages viewed on mobile without horizontal overflow.
Mobile tap target warnings visually validated for top nav.
Modal interactions successfully completed on mobile viewport.

coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible modals, pricing toggles, and at least one FAQ accordion per relevant page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks (Home CTAs, Pricing toggle) on mobile viewport

notes: Pay close attention to the small_tap_target layout warnings identified in the prescan, particularly when switching to the mobile viewport in Phase 4.
Since this is a clone, verify that 'javascript:void(0)' links correctly trigger expected UI components like modals instead of failing silently.

Engineering Lead Marcus Johnson Product Designer Aisha Patel Frontend Engineer James Kim Backend Engineer Team Directory by danyanovich FAQs Is Notion good for project management? Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Does Notion support templates for different industries? Yes, Notion offers project templates for various industries, from software and marketing to construction and educ

observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing.
